explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result or follows from one by plain instantiation. I grepped Mathlib for `even_abs`, `abs_even`, `Even.abs` and `Even/Odd (|…|)`. The only relevant hits were `odd_abs : Odd |a| ↔ Odd a` (Mathlib/Algebra/Order/Ring/Abs.lean) and `Int.natAbs_even`. Neither concerns `Even (|n| - k)`. Getting the target from `odd_abs` would also need `Int.even_sub` and the `Odd`/`Even` negation, which is more than a one- or two-line instantiation. I therefore did not count it.
